claim: Cache tag invalidation lets you invalidate multiple related cached objects with a single request using simple text string tags: instead of tracking and specifying individual URL paths, you tag objects during caching and then invalidate all objects that share a tag at once. Path-based invalidation and tag invalidation both remain available and can be used together.

evidence.quote: Cache tag invalidation is a CloudFront capability that lets you invalidate multiple related cached objects with a single request using simple text string tags.
Both methods remain available and can be used together.

Instead of tracking and specifying individual URL paths, you pre-tag objects during caching with descriptive labels (e.g., "homepage", "product:123", "user-ABC") and then invalidate all objects sharing a tag at once.
